# Brookside Party Warehouse

> Locally owned party supply store at 103 W 63rd Street in Brookside, Kansas City, Missouri.

## Visitor information

- Address: 103 W 63rd Street, Kansas City, MO 64113.
- Phone: 816-333-2332. Call for same-day balloon orders and availability.
- Email: bkspartywarehouse@gmail.com.
- Owner: Jerri Brandon.
- Monday-Wednesday: 9 am-7 pm.
- Thursday-Friday: 9 am-8 pm.
- Saturday: 9 am-6 pm.
- Sunday: 11 am-3 pm.
- Free street parking and a small lot. The store is next to Chase Bank.
- Holiday hours may differ. Call before making a special trip.

## What the store sells

Balloons and helium filling, custom balloon bouquets, pinatas, themed tableware, cards, Caspari paper goods, wedding supplies, and party decorations. Chiefs and football party supplies are featured on the homepage while supplies last. The website is a guide to the store, not a live inventory feed or online checkout.

Spookier is the upstairs costume floor, open year-round. It includes costumes, masks, wigs, makeup, props, and animatronics. Confirm stock and service details by phone.
